title: Инспектор Мишлен и билет в Париж  (The Michelin Inspector and the Ticket to Paris)

scenes.title: Invitation to Paris
scenes.summary: Olivier invites Katya to move to Paris with him and kisses her, until a jealous Denis triggers the fire alarm and spills red wine on Olivier.

scenes.title: Family Council
scenes.summary: After Timofey Ilyich gets his nose bandaged, Katya gathers Chef Barinov and Eleonora to announce that she is moving to Paris with Olivier.

scenes.title: An Adult Decision
scenes.summary: Eleonora and Chef Barinov recruit Denis and Nikita to scare Olivier off, while Kostya refuses to let his estranged father stay in their apartment.

scenes.title: The Stolen Wallet
scenes.summary: Timofey Ilyich returns because his wallet was stolen on the metro, and Nastya admits she spent their secret cash stash on a children's wardrobe.

scenes.title: Scuffle in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Denis and Nikita corner Olivier in the courtyard to warn him away from Katya, but Olivier easily fends them off until Katya breaks up the fight.

scenes.title: The Wardrobe and the Ambulance
scenes.summary: Nastya hands Kostya her tips and asks him to build the wardrobe tonight, while Chef Barinov learns that an ambulance has arrived for Eleonora.

scenes.title: The Inspector's ID
scenes.summary: While Eleonora stages a medical crisis with a paid doctor, Ainura brings Chef Barinov an ID card proving that Olivier Dubois is a Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Miraculous Recovery
scenes.summary: Katya decides to stay in Moscow to care for her mother, until Chef Barinov whispers to Eleonora that Olivier is a Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Harmony and Love
scenes.summary: Katya is bewildered by her parents' sudden support for her trip, and Chef Barinov explains to Eleonora that Olivier is a second undercover Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Who Will Assemble the Wardrobe
scenes.summary: While Denis and Nikita scheme with Timur, Kostya comes home to find his father has already built the wardrobe and orders him to dismantle it.

scenes.title: The Trap in the Room
scenes.summary: Kostya stubbornly struggles with the wardrobe at home, while in the kitchen Denis and Nikita tell a horrified Chef Barinov they planted contraband in Olivier's room.

scenes.title: The Suitcase with a Surprise
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov signs Lyova's supply order blindly as he rushes off, while Denis and Nikita realize the packet is locked inside Olivier's suitcase.

scenes.title: Police in the Room
scenes.summary: When the police knock on Olivier's door, Chef Barinov bursts in wearing his chef's toque and claims to be the hotel manager.

scenes.title: The French Embassy
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov invites Olivier to a farewell banquet and convinces the police that Olivier will call the French Embassy if they do not leave immediately.

scenes.title: A Deal with the Inspector
scenes.summary: When a woman steps out of Olivier's bathroom, Chef Barinov furiously confronts him, and Olivier offers a glowing Michelin report in exchange for silence.

scenes.title: The New Television
scenes.summary: Nastya shows Kostya a huge new television hanging on the wall, and Kostya immediately accuses his father of lying about the stolen wallet.

scenes.title: The Broken Screen
scenes.summary: After Kostya smashes the television, Nastya tells him she borrowed the money from her own father, and Timofey Ilyich knocks Kostya down for insulting his mother.

scenes.title: The Farewell Banquet
scenes.summary: At Katya's farewell banquet, Chef Barinov chooses his daughter's happiness over a Michelin star and exposes Olivier's infidelity in front of everyone.

scenes.title: The Report and Blackmail
scenes.summary: Katya breaks up with Olivier on the spot, and when he threatens to ruin the restaurant's Michelin chances, Eleonora silences him with compromising evidence.

scenes.title: The Hidden Wallet
scenes.summary: Kostya makes peace with his father and prepares to buy a new TV, until he finds Timofey Ilyich's wallet on the top shelf where Nastya hid it.
